subject: Engagement summary & POC setup - Cumulus AI
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@cumulusai.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Engagement summary & POC setup - Cumulus AI

Hi Lisa / Marco —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap so we all have the same starting point and a compact set of next steps to get the POC moving. I tried to keep this to the essentials.

Key pain points you shared
- High false positive rate on current entity extraction (esp. medical device IDs) causing extra manual review cycles
- API latency spikes during peak batch scoring windows impacting throughput SLAs
- Need for reproducible prompt/eval suite to compare model & quantization choices

Primary goals for the 4-week POC
1) Reduce entity-extraction false positives by >= 30% on the supplied sample set
2) Achieve median inference latency <= 120ms for single-document scoring under representative load (we'll simulate at 10 rps)
3) Delivery of a shareable prompt/eval bundle and baseline eval report for your team

Proposed scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- One model variant tuned for entity extraction + small reranker, hosted in a dedicated sandbox project
- Prompt/eval suite (sample_prompt_set_v1.json) and an initial evaluation report
- Short-lived KV prefix cache enabled + batching policy tuned for your 90th percentile length
- Weekly checkpoints (biweekly technical sync + weekly progress note)

Success metrics (to be used in acceptance)
- False positive reduction >= 30% vs your baseline set
- Median latency <= 120ms at 10 rps (95th percentile cap TBD in week 1)
- Signed mutual action plan and access granted within 5 business days of kickoff

Owners / roles
- Cumulus AI: Lisa (primary product owner), Marco (platform/SRE contact)
- Redwood: Vivek (AM, commercial), Monica (CS lead, onboarding & KPIs), Aditya (SE, infra & access)

Minimal access checklist we need from Cumulus AI by kickoff
- S3 link or secure share with a ~2k-sample anonymized dataset (See sample_prompt_set_v1 schema)
- Temporary service account or API key with read access to the dataset + a staging endpoint for integration tests
- SSO/IdP metadata if you want RBAC for the dedicated sandbox (optional for POC, recommended for Dedicated later)

Tentative timeline
- Target kickoff: 2027-04-05 (please confirm)
- Week 1: access & data ingestion, baseline eval run
- Week 2: model variant experiments + prompt tuning
- Week 3: performance tuning (batching/caching), latency testing under load
- Week 4: acceptance eval, handoff doc, and exec summary

Attachments sent with this message:
- mutual_action_plan_cumulusai.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestone dates)
- redwood_poc_scope.pdf (scope & terms summary)
- sample_prompt_set_v1.json (example schema for sample prompts)

Immediate asks (can do in parallel)
- Lisa: confirm kickoff date (OK to propose 2027-04-05)
- Marco: share S3 path or preferred secure transfer method and any network allowlists we should be aware of
- Lisa/Marco: confirm legal/compliance reddressers for sample data (PII scrubbing confirmed yes/no)

If you prefer, we can convert this into a short mutual-action plan card in HubSpot and lock dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
viv.k@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_cumulusai.xlsx] [Attachment: redwood_poc_scope.pdf] [Attachment: sample_prompt_set_v1.json]

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@cumulusai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement summary & POC setup - Cumulus AI

Thanks Vivek — this is very helpful and lines up with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side so expectations are explicit: 

Clarifications / constraints
- Dataset: we'll provide an anonymized S3 manifest but need to scrub all personal identifiers first; our privacy team wants the POC to run only on anonymized records
- Latency target: 120ms median is fine as target, but our product team would like the 95th percentile to be under 300ms if possible; we realize this may require tradeoffs and want to see numbers in week 3
- Compliance: Cumulus is SOC 2 Type II in progress; we will need a short note on how Redwood handles logs and retention during the POC (can you send a one-page summary?)

We are happy to target 2027-04-05 kickoff. Marco will share the S3 manifest and any VPC allowlist details by EOD Friday (2027-03-25).

Also: can your SE team ingest a small snippet (100 records) first to validate pipeline? That will help us avoid surprises.

Lisa Chen
Head of Product, Cumulus AI
lisa.chen@cumulusai.com | +1 (650) 555-2290

--
[Attachment: Cumulus-POC-constraints.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@cumulusai.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement summary & POC setup - Cumulus AI

Hi all — looping in a more technical view and a proposed minimal sequence for access validation.

Short plan for week 1 (technical)
1) Send over a 100-record sample ingestion job (Cumulus provides S3 URI); Redwood will run an ingestion + baseline eval within 24 hours of receipt
2) We will validate tokenization and entity mappings against your schema; if you have a mapping doc, please attach
3) For latency/load testing we will use a dedicated sandbox with the following settings: 2x g4dn-equivalent nodes, batching enabled (max batch size 8), KV cache TTL 15s; we can tune after first run

Access and security notes
- Please provide either a temporary IAM role (preferred) or a signed presigned URL list for the sample files
- We do not persist raw data outside the sandbox; logs are retained for 7 days during the POC unless you request otherwise
- Aditya will need SSO metadata only if you want RBAC; otherwise a simple API key for the sandbox is sufficient

Attachment: sample_prompt_set_v1.json (I attached a trimmed example with the prompt templates and expected labels column)

I can run the 100-record ingestion as soon as we have the S3 link. Marco/Lisa — when you share allowlist IPs, include the CIDR for your staging egress so we can validate backwards connectivity.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

--
[Attachment: sample_prompt_set_v1.json]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@cumulusai.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement summary & POC setup - Cumulus AI

Lisa / Marco — thanks for the quick replies and confirm on 2027-04-05 kickoff. A few housekeeping items before we lock the calendar: 

1) I am uploading the mutual action plan (attached) with milestone dates shifted to accommodate your internal privacy review. If you want changes to milestone owners/dates, call it out and we'll update the sheet.
2) Aditya will kick the 100-record ingestion once Marco posts the S3 manifest (target EOD 2027-03-25).
3) Compliance note: Monica will send a one-page POC data-retention & logs summary by EOD 2027-03-24.

Action items recap (who's doing what)
- Marco (Cumulus): Share S3 manifest + any allowlist/CIDR by 2027-03-25 (required)
- Lisa (Cumulus): Confirm PII scrubbing approach (ok to provide anonymized sample?) by 2027-03-25
- Aditya (Redwood): Run 100-record ingestion + baseline report within 24h of manifest receipt
- Monica (Redwood): Send POC retention & logs summary by 2027-03-24
- Vivek (Redwood): Finalize and attach mutual_action_plan_cumulusai.xlsx (attached)

If this looks good I'll create the HubSpot card and set the kickoff invite for 2027-04-05 10:00 AM PT. Please reply with any conflicts; otherwise we'll proceed.

Thanks all — excited to get started.

Best,
Vivek
